questions.question: How does the web search tool differ from the text editor tool in terms of who implements it?
options: Web search is fully implemented by Claude/Anthropic, with no server-side implementation needed at all
Web search requires the same manual implementation as the text editor tool
Web search requires a third-party API key configured by the developer
Web search only works when extended thinking is also enabled

questions.question: What does the max_uses field in the web search tool's schema control?
options: The maximum number of searches Claude can run per request
The maximum number of results returned per search
The maximum tokens spent on the search query
The number of days search results remain cached

questions.topic: why some tools are server-side only
questions.question: Why can Anthropic safely run web search entirely on its own infrastructure, while file edits and bash commands must stay client-side?
options: Web search never needs to touch anything private to the user, while file edits and bash commands are meaningless without access to the user's own environment
Web search is a lighter-weight operation that requires less compute
Client-side tools are always deprecated in favor of server-side ones
Anthropic does not have infrastructure capable of running file operations
